libghostty-vt Android third-party notices
==========================================

The Android libghostty-vt binaries in this application were built from Ghostty commit
15484b607eb5a518dedf1548247c923b8abaae7c. The emitted library statically includes the
Ghostty VT implementation, uucode 0.2.0, simdutf 5.2.8, Highway 1.2.0, and generated
Unicode data. The following notices are distributed with the APK.
